finalText:
CHANGELOG.md now has the 4.2.0 section, dated 2026-08-26. Out of 380 commits, most were dep bumps and internal refactors. Real user-facing changes came down to 9 items.

One is breaking: an expired token now returns `401` instead of `403`. One is a new feature: webhook deliveries retry automatically with backoff. The rest are fixes, the biggest being an HTTP client timer leak, crashes from a null pagination cursor across several endpoints, and the database logging full request bodies.

I skipped things like the trailing-slash-trim and token-parser wording tweaks. Those never touch what a user sees.
